from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReportEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's Q1 2025 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/SEC code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2025-01' or 'Q1 2025')")
    net_cash_increase: float | None = Field(description="The net increase in cash and cash equivalents for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 'CNY' or 'Yuan'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the cash flow line item, e.g., '现金及现金等价物净增加额'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[FinancialReportEntry]
